---
title: "A wrapped table with its caption in the margin"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
---

Without the extension, Quarto 1.10.20 fails a LaTeX build for a table with
its caption in the margin. With it, the wrapped table builds in LaTeX as a
tabular, and its caption goes to the margin.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cap-margin
#| tbl-cap: "A table with its caption in the margin."
#| tbl-cap-location: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
knitr::kable(head(cars, 2))
```

The paragraph after the table with its caption in the margin.
